findings.text: this round edits reckon/resources.py, which is outside the manifest's declared write paths and recorded only under outside_scope; the manifest states the widening could not be written because the pointer lock under ~/.config/reckon/crew/locks is read-only in the fenced home, so promotion sees an edit with no granted path behind it.

item_verdicts.call_sites: the landed change is test and formatting only, and I verified it against the production entry points the new cases reach: reckon/project_brief.py:126 (_load_payload's scope entry), reckon/project_maintenance_commands.py:1581 (the roadmap verb's scope entry), and reckon/resources.py:760 (_resolve_canonical, the reformatted call).
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from df37a76e2b to b244a3f57e: b6aa5ef074 and e66889ba96 are blank-line and wrapping fixes to reckon/resources.py, 251db84a0c adds the two cases and the covered_validations counter, and b244a3f57e adds the fragment paragraph; three files, +51/-1.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names the seven cases and three negative controls in tests/test_a_request_validates_the_tree_once.py, an importer population against the base, and ruff clean on the staged paths; s2-test.log records 9 passed at 251db84a0c, s2-after.log 7 passed at b6aa5ef074, and I re-measured the ruff clauses myself (format --check exit 0 at head against one reflow hunk at the base; ruff check 4 lines at both ends).
item_verdicts.goal: the source goal is that every MCP read enters the covered-tree and identity-index scopes once; this delta closes the two folded findings, and tests/test_a_request_validates_the_tree_once.py:439 and :458 add the cases the CLI entries at reckon/project_brief.py:126 and reckon/project_maintenance_commands.py:1581 lacked.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports the two folded findings landed as 251db84a0c and e66889ba96 with b6aa5ef074 and b244a3f57e carrying the separation fix and the evidence, the 7-to-9 pass delta, the CLI scope negative control, and the format and lint delta.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the recorded paths are reckon/mcp_deadlines.py, reckon/mcp.py, reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py, reckon/metadata_index.py, tests/test_a_request_validates_the_tree_once.py and the landing fragment; the diff also changes reckon/resources.py, which the manifest discloses under outside_scope as a widening the pointer lock would not record.

justifications.durability: negative-control-cli-scope.log shows each new case failing (pytest exit=1) when its own with metadata_index.discovery_file_scope() is replaced by if True, so both assertions are guards on the entry rather than on the read, and the format clause is held by the format gate I re-ran.
justifications.evidence: the worker's gate is the single test file at 251db84a0c (9 passed, EXIT=0 in s2-test.log) and I re-ran it at the delivered head for 9 passed; the importer population clause is recorded separately under failure_attribution rather than re-measured this round.
justifications.fit: reckon/resources.py:59-62 restores the two blank lines the module uses between top-level declarations and reclaims the formatter's own wrapping at line 763, and the new cases follow the Counter fixture idiom at tests/test_a_request_validates_the_tree_once.py:169.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/test_a_request_validates_the_tree_once.py:439 and :458 assert the covered tree is validated exactly once through each CLI entry, which is the half of reckon/project_brief.py:120 that no case covered before.
justifications.reuse: the delta adds no production definition; it extends the existing Counter at tests/test_a_request_validates_the_tree_once.py:134 with a covered_validations field, and my search of reckon/ for an existing covered-tree validation counter found only metadata_index._reuse_covered_once at reckon/metadata_index.py:928, which the fixture wraps rather than copies.
justifications.scope_discipline: reckon/resources.py is outside the manifest's declared write paths and appears only under outside_scope, while the test file and the fragment are inside them.
